say:38:1011116029:0.source_cn: 详情由莱卡队长代为传达吧。请随我来。

say:1:1011117002:0.text: Much better... I'll never sense the magic around corrupted roots again.

say:3:1011117004:0.text: I did what I had to do.

say:0:1011119001:0.text: That's strange. They seem to know the Dusk Patrollers' routine very well.
say:0:1011119001:0.source_cn: 怪了，这些人怎么会对薄暮巡游队的行动时间了解得这么清楚。

say:1:1011119002:0.text: Sparing humans but targeting the Wilders... It's a deliberate attempt to stoke conflict on both sides!
say:1:1011119002:0.source_cn: 放过人类，却针对绿裔……这是故意挑起两边的矛盾！

say:2:1011119003:0.text: Who's behind all this?! I will pierce through that scoundrel's chest!
say:2:1011119003:0.source_cn: 谁在指使他们？！我要用枪刺穿那家伙的胸膛！

say:0:1011120001:0.text: The bandits are still here! Let's make them spill some information!
say:0:1011120001:0.source_cn: 这些盗匪，果然还在！得让他们从嘴里吐出点消息来！

say:4:1011124002:1.source_cn: 真是的，你一走就是好几年，连封信也不给我写！托布莱恩他...

say:7:1011124004:1.text: Well... Hmmm... I was in a hurry to bring us back a savior!
say:7:1011124004:1.source_cn: 呃……那是……我这不是急着带救星回来嘛！
say:7:1011124004:1.male: Well... Hmmm... I was in a hurry to bring us back a savior!
say:7:1011124004:1.female: Well... Hmmm... I was in a hurry to bring us back a savior!

say:8:1011124005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，失礼了。这几位是你的朋友吗？你们好，我叫莱卡，是...

say:9:1011124006:1.text: Lorsan has been a bit of a troublemaker since he was young. I'm sorry if he caused any trouble for you along the way.
say:9:1011124006:1.source_cn: 洛桑从小就顽皮，一路上麻烦你们照顾了。

say:10:1011124007:1.text: Come on, Sister! It's been three years. Can't we catch up for a moment without digging into the past!
